statement: For the plus Fermat cubic, the based cuspidally central pro3 quotient N/[N,I] is exactly C times over T3E the full rank-ten abelian group V, where C is the class-two quotient of the once-punctured elliptic curve at the rational cusp O. The full intrinsic class-two group maps onto it with central kernel ker(exterior-square V to exterior-square T3E), free of rank44. Every rank-ten abelian section class lifts to this quotient, and every fiber is a torsor under explicitly specified restricted Z3 sequences over rational primes.
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d); section51.16, folios733v-736v, scans172-178, (371)-(379), through the exact intrinsic quotient maps E36.1 and E36.2.
notes: The geometric cusp map t -> (t_O, t modulo diagonal) has determinant1 and explicit inverse. The same O tangent is used for the actual open immersion and abelianization, proving arithmetic equivariance and preserving the origin. A pro3 proper elliptic section is extended by zero at every other prime and lifted using the opened Borne-Emsalem-Stix Theorem5.10 for the singleton torsion packet {O}; projection back to pro3 and the exact fiber product establish all abelian fibers. A direct proof H0(Q,V)=0 eliminates extra geometric stabilizers, and Kummer theory explicitly evaluates the central fiber. The program checks only the integral lattice maps. The rank44 further lifting problem remains and E31 supplies classes failing it.
